report.summary: The reconnect test no longer relies on a fixed 100 ms wait. The fake daemon holds the reconnect response until the test has checked that the turn is still queued and that no prompt reached the daemon, then releases it and checks that the turn runs. It follows the existing holdHealth pattern, and cleanup releases the gate if the test fails. The Bun install filters match the real package names: the root is 'tempo', and '@tempo/tempod' pulls in @tempo/protocol and @tempo/settings. The daemon's code imports only those packages, effect, the ACP SDK and built-ins. The container test script and version check import only local files. The docs-only path skips the Playwright and Chromium steps, so dropping the Playwright version read there is safe. Tab 06 and docs/CI.md are updated in the same change. Only two minor documentation notes remain; nothing blocks the merge.

findings.text: The paragraph about the failed run 38469401920 sits under 'Rules for future changes', just before rule 1. It describes one past incident rather than a rule, so it would fit better in its own section or in CI_PLAYBOOK.md.

The new audit document mentions an optional third-party skill install command ('npx skills add ...'). This is fine because the change does not run or depend on it, but repo docs should not suggest unvetted tools (rule 11 asks before adding dependencies). Consider dropping that sentence.
